summary: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NCLH) filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary NCL Corporation Ltd. irrevocably fixed the settlement method to cash settlement for all exchanges of its 1.125% and 2.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2027. This election, effective May 29, 2026, means exchanges will be settled in cash rather than shares, reducing diluted weighted-average share count guidance by ~2M shares for Q2 2026 and ~4M shares for FY 2026. No price, premium, or advisor is stated. This is a mechanical note-holder election, not a special situation. Watch for any follow-on capital structure changes.
